description: Contiguous beta Silver Auto substage labels for a selected well and copper stage.
sql: SELECT * FROM (WITH stage_window AS ( SELECT well_name, CAST(stage_num AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS stage_num, CAST(stage_start_ts AS timestamp) AS stage_start_ts, CAST(stage_end_ts AS timestamp) AS stage_end_ts FROM featurestore:nextier_copper_stage_index_v1 WHERE well_name = :well_name AND CAST(stage_num AS DOUBLE PRECISION) = :stage_num LIMIT 1 ), base AS (SELECT a.substage_label, CAST(a.record_ts AS timestamp) AS ts FROM featurestore:nextier_auto_beta_labels_v1 a JOIN stage_window s ON s.well_name = a.well_name AND CAST(a.record_ts AS timestamp) >= s.stage_start_ts AND CAST(a.record_ts AS timestamp) <= s.stage_end_ts WHERE a.well_name = :well_name AND a.concentration_feature = CASE WHEN :concentration_feature = 'auto' THEN COALESCE((SELECT wc.concentration_feature FROM featurestore:nextier_well_conc_channel_v1 wc WHERE wc.well_name = :well_name), 'auger') ELSE :concentration_feature END AND a.record_ts IS NOT NULL AND a.substage_label IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(a.substage_label) <> 'na'), marked AS (SELECT substage_label, ts, CASE WHEN LAG(substage_label) OVER (ORDER BY ts) IS DISTINCT FROM substage_label THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_group FROM base), grouped AS (SELECT substage_label, ts, SUM(is_new_group) OVER (ORDER BY ts ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS group_id FROM marked) SELECT substage_label, MIN(ts) AS start_ts, CASE WHEN LOWER(substage_label) IN ('open_well', 'stage_start', 'stage_end', 'close_well') THEN MIN(ts) ELSE MAX(ts) END AS end_ts, CASE LOWER(substage_label) WHEN 'open_well' THEN '#2563EB' WHEN 'stage_start' THEN '#16A34A' WHEN 'ttr' THEN '#9333EA' WHEN 'pad' THEN '#F97316' WHEN 'slurry' THEN '#DC2626' WHEN 'flush' THEN '#0D9488' WHEN 'stage_end' THEN '#DB2777' WHEN 'close_well' THEN '#EAB308' ELSE '#787878' END AS color, COUNT(*) AS sample_count FROM grouped GROUP BY group_id, substage_label ORDER BY MIN(ts)) q
